definitions.short: properly, to eliminate , i.e. (intransitively) to dry up
definitions.full: H5405. nashath נָשַׁת verb be dry, parched ; — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular נָשָׁ֑תָּה בַּצָּמָא לְשׁוֺנָם Isa 41:17 (on dagesh forte affect. see Ges § 20i ); also figurative גְבוּרָתָם נָָֽשְׁתָה Jer 51:30 , their might is dry , i.e. fails. Niph`al Perfect 3plural consecutive מֵהַיָּ֑ם וְנִשְּׁתומַֿיִם Isa 19:5 and water shall be dried up from the sea ; compare Imperfect מַיּם יַנָָּֽתְשׁוּ Jer 18:14 , where read probably יִנָָּֽשְׁחוּ (Gf Gie and others).

occurrences.englishText: The waters will fail from the sea, and the river will be wasted and become dry.
The poor and needy seek water, and there is none.
The mighty men of Babylon have stopped fighting,
